purpose: Keep data acquisition, validation, domain calculation, orchestration and presentation concerns separated and fail-closed.

rules: Runtime datasets are loaded through BreakMetricDataLoader.
Runtime dataset paths are same-origin data/*.json paths.
Versioned batch loads must observe one stable runtime fingerprint.
Fetched datasets are validated before activation.
Runtime dependencies fail closed before application startup.
EV, probability, market evidence and readiness remain separate states.
Missing or unverified market evidence must not be coerced to zero-value evidence.
Async state transitions use coordinators so stale work cannot overwrite newer user state.
Browser persistence is isolated behind the storage abstraction.
